name: Saltmere
description: A walled port on a grey estuary, all tarred timber, gull-cries and good manners. The Saltmere Syndicate runs the harbour from its back rooms while the Regency's harbourmaster pretends not to notice. Everything here has a price, and the price is posted.
travel_text: Salt wind off the estuary, the creak of rigging, and gulls wheeling over the road like a bad omen with wings.

events.text: A sea-chest lies stranded on a sandbar, the tide already turning around it.

success.message: You haul it ashore before the water takes it and pry the lid. Wet coin, a good knife, a flask of rum.

fail.message: The tide takes the chest, and half your dignity with it.

events.text: A green lantern blinks three times from a dark inlet, then twice, then three times again.

success.message: A smugglers' signal, and a stash beneath the third piling. You take a modest handful and re-hang the lantern the way you found it.

fail.message: You wander into the signal's line of sight. Somewhere out on the water, an oar stops. A crossbow quarrel thuds into a post a hand's breadth from your ear.

events.text: The tide is coming in across the flats faster than seems right, a brown tongue creeping under your boots.

success.message: You read the ripples and cut across a ridge of shell. You arrive dry and slightly pleased with yourself.

fail.message: The water reaches your waist before you find footing. Everything you carry is soaked.

events.text: A gull the size of a cat lands on your pack and stares at you with total confidence.

success.message: You offer a heel of bread. It takes it, and a salt-crusted coin it was hiding drops at your feet.

fail.message: It swipes your last ration and flies off, shrieking in what sounds a lot like laughter.

events.text: A bell tolls from somewhere in the fog, slow and out of tune, though there is no tower on this stretch of coast.

success.message: You follow the sound to a beached hulk where a drowned bell-ringer's rope still sways. Below it sits a tin box with a few coins in it.

fail.message: You wander the fog for an hour and come out exactly where you started.

events.text: A sailor sits on a rock with a broken oar across his knees, watching the tide go out without him.

success.message: You splint his arm. He tells you, grateful, that the Syndicate's back door is the third crate on the quay with a red nail in it.

fail.message: Your splint is clumsy, and he winces. He thanks you anyway, in the way of men who are going to complain later.

sights: gulls wheeling over a fishing boat like a white storm
a rusted anchor taller than a man, sunk to the crown in sand
salt-crusted rope fences along the flats
a line of fishing nets drying like grey flags
the horizon smeared with distant sails
a fog bank sitting on the water like a sleeping animal
dead kelp heaped along the tideline, black briar threaded through it
brown pelicans on a pier piling, grumpy
